edits.before: - Vex Personal Space (Fear): matchup-defining — Shield + AoE fear that punishes dashes — never dash onto her while her passive glows. Check it before every step-up. - W Personal Space is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Vex Personal Space (Fear) is 16s at rank 1: shield plus AoE fear that punishes dashes — never Shadow Surge onto her while her passive glows. - Your own W (16s) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult is 140s and answers fights, not waves.
